exposure: botulinum toxin injection to the pelvic floor
outcome: patient-reported global impression of improvement scale
cohort: The study included 48 consecutive women with myofascial pelvic pain syndrome of the pelvic floor who had failed conservative treatment and received botulinum toxin injections.
finding: Of the 46 women who attended follow-up, 34 (74%) reported an improvement in their symptoms at 3-6 months.
